trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops on its own. There is no separate task: work the roadmap in order, finish 100% completion last, and the platinum lands when the final trophy does.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase trophy list.

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to its end. It is the first story mission and cannot be missed: just follow the opening until the mission completes.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; KeenGamer GTA 6 trophy roadmap.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Story trophy, unmissable. While you are in Chapter 1, meditate at Jason's house the first chance you get: that spot feeds the only possibly missable trophy, Positive Mental Attitude.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; PowerPyx and GTABase flag the Chapter 1 meditation spot.

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Story trophy, unmissable. The name is printed as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Story trophy, unmissable. Keep side strands and activities for later unless they sit right on your route.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. Story trophy, unmissable. After this chapter only the final mission stands between you and the story gold.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission. It pops the moment the story ends, and it opens the 100% completion checklist that A Long Road needs.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Breakfast Run mission when it appears in the story. A story mission trophy: play the mission through and it unlocks on completion.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission in the story. Plan the approach the mission offers, finish the job, and the trophy follows.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Child's Play mission in the story. Story mission trophy: it unlocks when the mission completes.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Headliners mission in the story. Story mission trophy: finish the mission and it unlocks.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission in the story. Story mission trophy: it unlocks on mission completion.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission in the story. Story mission trophy: finish the operation and it unlocks.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist, which opens after the story. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy and estimates about 200 hours to the platinum at difficulty 4 out of 10. Everything else in this guide feeds it: story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and counts. Work the checklist line by line once the story is done; this trophy pops with the last line, and the platinum follows.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; PowerPyx (hardest trophy, about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough).

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count, and you can mix them. Your stunt count is tracked in the stats menu; work through jump spots as you travel rather than hunting all 250 in one go.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; stunt types per FullSweep GTA 6 trophy guide.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once (KeenGamer counts nine). Sample one of each: races, fishing, arcade, bowling, the shooting range, drone races and the rest. One try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish them all.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; KeenGamer (nine activity types).

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (PSNProfiles count). Work through each range's challenges one at a time and repeat a challenge until the gold medal lands; accuracy first, then speed, since misses cost more than slow shots.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; PSNProfiles (42 challenges).

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at all 14 locations (KeenGamer). Learn each course's line first, then race it to win; cut corners only where the checkpoints allow, and win once per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; KeenGamer (14 locations).

trophies.guide: Win 20 different race events. Any race type counts, but repeats of the same event do not: vary the events and work down the race list.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find Cal's fishing challenge and out-fish him. Match your bait and timing to the fish the challenge shows; a steady retrieve beats yanking the line.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Play any arcade cabinet through to its end. Pick the shortest game on the cabinet and finish one full run.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Follow Andy's mission strand to its last mission and complete it. Stranger and side strands unlock as the story advances; check the map for Andy's marker after each chapter.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Follow Kenton's mission strand to its last mission and complete it. Keep playing his strand whenever his marker appears; the final mission closes the strand.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Follow Billy's mission strand to its last mission and complete it. Billy's strand runs alongside the story; finish his missions in order.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands. PowerPyx counts 14 stranger strands in the game, so you can pick any 8 and finish them. Work the stranger markers as they appear across Leonida; each finished strand counts one.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; PowerPyx (14 stranger strands).

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Follow Randy's mission strand to its last mission and complete it. Finish his missions in order until the strand closes.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Follow Tyrone's mission strand to its last mission and complete it. His strand closes with its final mission.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida (KeenGamer). This is the one trophy that may be missable: PowerPyx and GTABase both flag it, because the first meditation spot, at Jason's house, can only be used early in the story, in Chapter 1. Meditate there the first chance you get in Chapter 1, then meditate at every other spot as you find it. If you are past Chapter 1 and never meditated at Jason's house, this trophy may already be out of reach on this playthrough.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; PowerPyx and GTABase (only possibly missable trophy; first spot in Chapter 1, Jason's house); KeenGamer (18 spots).

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Follow Bret's strand until he asks you to hunt a unique animal, then track and take it down. The hunt is his request; use the tracking cues the game gives and take a clean shot.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Find card packs across Leonida, in shops and out in the world, and finish three full sets. Trade duplicates where the game lets you; a set completes when its last card lands.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 different locations. It counts distinct spots, so keep moving: each new location you use it at adds one. Fold it into your travel between missions rather than grinding it in one place.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's checklist tasks across activities and the world; work through them as you play and the count climbs. Fifty is well under the total, so pick the easiest ones first.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Build a 4-star wanted level while playing with your partner, then lose it and escape. Break line of sight, stay out of the search area, and keep moving until the stars clear; doing it with your partner beside you is what counts.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner while keeping your wanted level. Chain the three robberies in one run: hit a shop, move straight to the next, and keep the heat on you the whole way without losing it.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 distinct vehicles. Drive or encounter them; variety counts, repeats do not. Try every class as you travel: cars, bikes, boats, planes and anything unusual parked around Leonida.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in one use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group, activate Combat Focus with several enemies in front of you, and drop five before it ends. A crowded fight is the right moment.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at Vice City International Airport. Grab a plane on the tarmac and take off without following the normal departure routine.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Get into a Rhino tank and use it. The description is the joke: find a Rhino, climb in, and cause havoc with it until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and guards, take the goods, and leave unseen. If anyone spots you, the attempt fails, so plan the route in and out first.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time. Five separate vault robberies, each ending in a clean getaway. Plan the escape before you crack the vault; the escape is half the job.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit a truck on the road, take its cargo, and get away clean.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every named area of the map; the in-game map shows what is still unexplored. Sweep the state district by district, including the islands and the far corners.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Hit one illegal operation per gang across Leonida; each gang's operation counts once, so work through the gangs in turn.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view. Any beachfront bar on Ocean Beach does it; sit, order, and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through the showroom's front window and out onto the street, the way the old games taught you.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through on your throw. Play a game there; the follow-through is what the trophy watches.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build your partnership's appeal until it pops. Play co-op activities with your partner and keep the partnership going; the trophy follows sustained play together.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make a story choice. This is a hidden trophy tied to a decision point in the story; the exact choice is not confirmed yet, so play the story and choose when the game asks you to. It will pop on a choice you make.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; method unconfirmed at the time of writing.

trophies.guide: Fail at something once, then succeed on the second try. The exact trigger is not confirmed yet, but the description points at retrying: an activity or mission failed once, then passed on the next attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; method unconfirmed at the time of writing.

trophies.guide: A hidden trophy with an unconfirmed unlock, most likely tied to a strange encounter or easter egg in the world. KeenGamer lists the method as still being confirmed. Explore the odd corners of Leonida and see what you find; do not trust any single claimed method until two sources agree.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; KeenGamer (method still being confirmed).

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Perform a melee drive-by elimination. The precise method is still being confirmed (KeenGamer): attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Try it on a lone target on an open road.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; KeenGamer (precise method still being confirmed).

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until the cumulative total reaches $250,000. Keep converting Marked Bills as you earn them; the total is cumulative across the whole game, so it climbs as you play.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Big purchases count the same as small ones, so buy weapons, clothes, cars and properties as you go and the total adds up.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 purchasable garage properties (KeenGamer). Buy each garage as you can afford it; the trophy pops when the last one is yours.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.sources: Official description via Exophase; KeenGamer (8 garages).

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles you own to the Scooter Bros app. Own ten vehicles, open the app, and register each one; the count is cumulative.
trophies.name: On the Spot
